414010101.text: How very strange... What is the matter with this Kamera?

414010103.text: I think it's broken... Well, maybe not broken, but it's certainly not working like it's supposed to.

414010104.text: I ordered a batch from Fontaine a while back.

414010105.text: The person who sold it to me said that this particular kind of Kamera features the very latest technology from Fontaine.

414010106.text: Supposedly, it can print photos in a special hue and add in some special effects, or something. So I bought one to try it out.

414010107.text: But try as I might, I can't get it to print out photos properly. I don't know whether I'm using it wrong, or if it's just faulty.

414010108.text: Maybe there's some trick to it that I'm not getting...

414010109.text: So, how about you? Much of a Kamera Konnoisseur yourself?

414010111.text: I'll take that as a yes! So, could I get you to help?

414010114.text: I'm guessing you're a traveler? You must have a lot of experiences under your belt.

414010115.text: What I'd like you to do is use this Kamera to take a picture of something with a strong color.

414010116.text: Once you've taken a snap, if you could please bring me the photo. I want to see if I can isolate the source of the issue...

414010117.text: And if I can't, I'll take the photos to the seller and see what he has to say. With the photos as hard evidence, he won't be able to dismiss the issue.

414010113.text: Oh, I see... Well, never mind, it's simple enough to use... Would you mind giving me a hand anyway?
